title: Stock
summary: A company's stock: warehouses (optionally per branch); receipts, issues, and adjustments that go draft → posted → cancelled with gapless numbers (BM/BK/PS) and the period lock; a ledger of every movement with its value by moving average or FIFO (the costing kit), chosen per company and locked once stock moves; balances per item and warehouse that never go negative and are never dated backwards; cancellation by exact reversing rows. Pages for stock on hand, the stock card, and the movement report (opening, in, out, closing). Offers StockLedger so purchasing, sales, and a POS move stock inside their own transaction. Keeps item code and name current from items.item.changed.
when_to_use: The app keeps goods in one or more warehouses and must know what is there and what it is worth: a warehouse log, a shop, a distributor, a kitchen store.
when_not_to_use: Lots, serial numbers, expiry dates, or rack locations — a later version of this module.
Transfers between warehouses, stock counts, picking and packing — the stock-transfer, stock-count, and wms modules build on StockLedger.
Revaluing history after a back-dated movement — not done: movements are dated forward per item and warehouse.

ports.name: Items
ports.description: Find, check, and convert the units of the items stock moves.

ports.name: Numbers
ports.description: Declare the numbering of receipts, issues, and adjustments and take the next number inside the posting's transaction.

ports.name: Periods
ports.description: Declare the inventory area and refuse postings and cancellations dated in a closed period.

ports.name: Branches
ports.description: The company's branches a warehouse may belong to; without it every warehouse belongs to the company as a whole.

permissions.name: stock.cancel

permissions.name: stock.manage
